records.observation: JFrame Jumpshot-4 implements TopControl; default close DO_NOTHING. Registers itself in TopWindow.First before constructing FirstPanel(isApplet,filename,view_ID) and FirstMenuBar(isApplet,panel), without disposing prior First; failures leave partial registry and no rollback. Installs closing listener; constructor does not pack/show/init. init delegates panel.init only. Three TopControl setters retrieve respective panel JButton and setEnabled; no explicit menu synchronization, null/EDT guard. checkVersion prints java.version and lexically String.compareTo 1.2.0, warns if less but does not reject; not semantic version/classfile compatibility validation, null property unchecked. main sequence checkVersion, parse args, Debug.initTextArea, print start, construct frame, pack, TopWindow.layoutIdealLocations, setVisible(true), init. No invokeLater/thread handoff here. Thus TopWindow layout normally establishes Control only under its AUTO_WINDOWS_LOCATION branch, before panel.init; FirstPanel constructor may have earlier side effects still pending reading. No direct Parameters initialization or renderer propagation here. CLI static defaults isApplet=false, filename=null, view_ID=-1, no reset per invocation. Last non-option filename wins; filename optional; leading hyphen always option, no -- escape. Help -h/-help/--help prints stale Usage java timelines.MainFrame and exits0; -debug/-profile set corresponding global flags true; -v increments index then Integer.parseInt into view_ID with no range validation; missing argument AIOOB uncaught. Unknown option reports 1-based position, exits1. NumberFormatException catch spans whole argument loop: prints prior successful view assignments plus failing option and stacktrace, returns normally, remaining args skipped and prior static assignments retained, main proceeds to GUI construction. For example -v bad file skips file and retains earlier/default view ID; negative numeric view accepted as consumed value. indexOrderStr uses st/nd/rd only for exact1/2/3 else th, so21th; diagnostic only.
